proposition: Nafsat I praises Shāhrukh as having restored the Sharīʿa (abolishing the dīvān-i yarghū) and states the judge's duty not to fear the powerful; these are flattering claims addressed to the man judging him.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to the ruler who was judging him
Melvin-Koushki, The Quest for a Universal Science (Yale 2012)
